description.p: A native replacement for GamaKay's Windows app: lighting, keymaps and macros for the LK67, written straight to the keyboard's onboard memory over USB.
Nothing stays resident — every command writes to the keyboard and exits — and the keyboard keeps typing while it is configured, because the kernel's HID driver stays bound.

ul.li: Lighting modes, brightness, speed and colour, with a live preview
Remap keys on the base and Fn layers, across the board's 8 profiles
A macro recorder, and a scriptable command line tool

description.p: First release: lighting, keymaps, macros, the GUI and CLI, and packages for Arch, Debian/Ubuntu, Fedora/RHEL and AppImage.
